keynums.label: BlackRock Stake in Pristine Logistics & Infraprojects

bull_bear.body:
- Executed Rs. 1,150 Million in new Axis Bank credit facilities (loan agreements signed 2 July 2026, following board approval on 23 May 2026): an Rs. 850 Million, 9-year term loan at 9.25% p.a. to fully refinance high-cost debt led by Aditya Birla Finance, plus Rs. 300 Million working capital (fund-based cash credit + non-fund-based bank guarantees) at 8.25%.
- Completed sale of a non-core land and building asset at Madhavaram, Chennai for Rs. 180 Million on 30 June 2026, in line with the NCLT-approved resolution plan, to further strengthen the balance sheet.
- Raised Rs. 930.3 Million via a Rights Issue in FY26 (11:5 ratio) to meet the Minimum Public Shareholding requirement of 25% public float.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Pristine Group-backed, Chennai-headquartered integrated logistics player with 7+ decades of history and strong port-based expertise spanning Mining Logistics, Container Freight Stations (CFS), Multi-Modal Logistics Parks (MMLP) and Warehousing & 3PL.
- Operates the first and only private rail-linked terminal in Chennai (Chennai MMLP) and the largest Chennai CFS by size and volume with 10%+ market share; Chennai CFS was rated the top-performing CFS in the Southern Region by NICDC Logistics Data Services in FY23, FY24, FY25 and FY26.
- Strong CFS presence at South and East ports (Chennai, Tuticorin, Visakhapatnam) driving EXIM trade in the Southern region, alongside decades-long relationships with port authorities, PSUs and large industrial clients in mining logistics.
- Backed by Pristine Logistics & Infraprojects Limited, in which BlackRock owns 57.5%, giving Sical strong capital backing, improved governance/financial discipline, execution scale and credibility for tender enablement.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Turnaround History] Sical went into insolvency in March 2021 due to a group-wide liquidity crisis (asset write-downs during FY21-FY23); Pristine Group acquired the company in January 2023 under an NCLT-approved resolution plan, initiating the current re-establishment and turnaround phase.
- [Corporate Restructuring] On 9 April 2026, promoter entity Pristine Malwa Logistics Park Private Limited was amalgamated into another promoter group entity, Pristine Logistics & Infraprojects Limited, to simplify the corporate structure.
- [Corporate History] Founded in 1955 as South India Corporation (Agencies) Ltd. (later renamed Sical Logistics Ltd.); Coffee Day Group acquired a majority stake in 2011, prior to the company's later insolvency and the Pristine Group acquisition.
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: Sical Logistics positions itself as a Pristine Group-backed, diversified Southern-India multi-modal logistics player moving from a post-insolvency turnaround into structural growth across Mining Logistics, Terminals (CFS/MMLP) and Warehousing & 3PL.
